set system host-name CE1.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set protocols rstp.explanation: Enables RSTP (Quick Generate Tree Protocol) protocols.

unit 0 family ethernet-switching interfa.explanation: Configure the interface as an ethnet exchange mode and set the interface mode as an access mode.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit number to distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

delete interfaces ge-0/0/1.explanation: The command fragment `delete interfaces [parameter1]` removes the configuration for the specified interface (`[parameter1]`) from the Junos device.

disable.explanation: Deletes the disablement status of the interface and allows the interface to be enabled.
